capabilities: Scan a folder or vault for similar notes using five-dimension similarity scoring
Compare two notes side by side with per-dimension score bars and common/unique keywords
Generate merge drafts in a separate folder while leaving source notes untouched
Tune similarity threshold, scan scope, and per-dimension weights
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. All processing is local; no notes are sent to external AI services. A sample vault is included in the repository for trying the workflow.
problem: Vaults naturally accumulate drafts, copied ideas, and near-duplicate notes, and Obsidian has no built-in way to detect them or consolidate them safely.

relations.evidence: Dualyze Notes is part of the DualyzeAI workflow.
AI Context Pack — turn organised notes into AI-ready context packs

summary: Local similarity scanner that finds overlapping or near-duplicate notes, compares them side by side, and generates merge drafts without modifying originals.
